properties.description: This pipeline runs a PyOPIA demo analysis, generating figures and statistics from copepod image data and packaging the results into a STAC output.
properties.name: pyopia_demo_pipeline
properties.cwl:
cwlVersion: v1.2
$namespaces:
  s: https://schema.org/
  edam: http://edamontology.org/
$graph:
- class: Workflow
  id: pyopia_demo_pipeline
  doc: This pipeline runs the PyOPIA demo analysis for Norway.
  inputs: []
  steps:
    step_pyopia:
      run: '#pyopia_demo_sintef'
      in: []
      out:
      - particles_figure
      - vd_copepods
      - vd_copepods_per_L
      - netcdf_statistics
      - metadata
    step_2stac2:
      run: '#2stac2_pyopia_pipeline'
      in:
        simulation: step_pyopia/netcdf_statistics
        particles_figure: step_pyopia/particles_figure
        vd_copepods: step_pyopia/vd_copepods
        vd_copepods_per_L: step_pyopia/vd_copepods_per_L
        metadata: step_pyopia/metadata
      out:
      - stac_result
  outputs:
  - id: wf_outputs
    outputSource:
    - step_2stac2/stac_result
    type: Directory
  requirements:
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
  s:name: pyopia_demo_pipeline
  s:description: 'This pipeline runs a PyOPIA demo analysis, generating figures and
    statistics from copepod image data and packaging the results into a STAC output.

    '
  s:keywords:
  - pyopia
  - simulation
  s:softwareVersion: 0.1.0
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Miguel Correia
    s:email: miguel.r.correia@inesctec.pt
  s:codeRepository: https://github.com/SINTEF/pyopia/tree/main
  s:dateCreated: '2025-11-24T23:38:39Z'
  s:identifier: urn:apkg:workflow:inesctec:pt:pyopia_demo_pipeline:0.1.0
  s:sdDatePublished: '2025-11-24T23:42:33.630551Z'
  s:sdPublisher:
    class: Organization
    name: Application Package Registry
    url: https://iliad-registry.inesctec.pt
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: pyopia_demo_sintef
  baseCommand: uv
  arguments:
  - run
  - /app/script.py
  inputs: []
  outputs:
  - id: netcdf_statistics
    type: File
    format: edam:format_3650
    outputBinding:
      glob: pyopiaproject/processed/pyopiaproject-STATS.nc
  - id: particles_figure
    type: File
    format: edam:format_3603
    outputBinding:
      glob: pyopiaproject/particles.png
  - id: vd_copepods
    type: File
    format: edam:format_3603
    outputBinding:
      glob: pyopiaproject/vd_copepods.png
  - id: vd_copepods_per_L
    type: File
    format: edam:format_3603
    outputBinding:
      glob: pyopiaproject/vd_copepods_per_L.png
  - id: metadata
    type: File
    format: edam:format_3464
    outputBinding:
      glob: pyopiaproject/nc_metadata.json
  requirements:
    NetworkAccess:
      networkAccess: true
    EnvVarRequirement:
      envDef:
        PATH: /app/.local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    ResourceRequirement: {}
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/pyopia-demo-sintef:0.1.0
  s:name: pyopia_demo_sintef
  s:description: Analysis of a small image example dataset using PyOPIA.
  s:keywords:
  - pyopia
  s:programmingLanguage: python
  s:softwareVersion: 0.1.0
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: SINTEF OCEAN
    s:url: https://sintef.no/en/ocean/
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: 'NO'
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: SINTEF OCEAN
    s:url: https://sintef.no/en/ocean/
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: 'NO'
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Raymond Nepstad
    s:email: raymond.nepstad@sintef.no
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Volker Hoffmann
    s:email: volker.hoffmann@sintef.no
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Antoine Pultier
    s:email: antoine.pultier@sintef.no
  s:contributor:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Miguel Correia
    s:email: miguel.r.correia@inesctec.pt
  s:codeRepository: https://github.com/SINTEF/pyopia/tree/main
  s:dateCreated: '2025-10-29T18:07:13Z'
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: 2stac2_pyopia_pipeline
  baseCommand: python
  arguments:
  - /opt/2stac2.py
  inputs:
    simulation:
      format: edam:format_3650
      doc: simulation NetCDF file
      type: File
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --file
    particles_figure:
      format: edam:format_3603
      doc: particles_figure
      type: File?
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --file
    vd_copepods:
      format: edam:format_3603
      doc: vd_copepods
      type: File?
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --file
    vd_copepods_per_L:
      format: edam:format_3603
      doc: vd_copepods_per_L
      type: File?
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --file
    metadata:
      format: edam:format_3464
      doc: metadata file description
      type: File
      loadContents: true
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --metadata
        valueFrom: $(runtime.outdir + '/multiple_metadata.json')
  outputs:
    stac_result:
      outputBinding:
        glob: stac_result
      type: Directory
      doc: STAC output
  requirements:
    EnvVarRequirement:
      envDef:
        PATH: /opt/conda/envs/application/bin:/opt/conda/condabin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    ResourceRequirement: {}
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/2stac2:0.3.1
    InplaceUpdateRequirement:
      inplaceUpdate: true
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing: "${\n  const content = JSON.parse(inputs.metadata.contents);\n  const\
        \ metadata = [];\n  metadata.push({...content, filename:inputs[\"simulation\"\
        ].basename});\n  metadata.push({...content, filename:inputs[\"particles_figure\"\
        ].basename , media_type:\"image/png\"});\n  metadata.push({...content, filename:inputs[\"\
        vd_copepods\"].basename , media_type:\"image/png\"});\n  metadata.push({...content,\
        \ filename:inputs[\"vd_copepods_per_L\"].basename , media_type:\"image/png\"\
        });\n  return [{\"class\": \"File\", \"basename\": \"multiple_metadata.json\"\
        , \"contents\": JSON.stringify(metadata) }];\n}\n"
  s:name: 2stac2_pyopia_pipeline
  s:softwareVersion: 0.3.1
  s:description: 2stac2 tool to transform pyopia simulation files into a STAC
  s:keywords:
  - stac
  - metadata
  - pyopia
  s:programmingLanguage: python
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Miguel Correia
    s:email: miguel.r.correia@inesctec.pt
  s:dateCreated: '2025-11-17T16:08:31Z'
